notes.title: Change of release date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39064683/7f0637eeca4786464cb9abea3db214314ce91802.png

Hello friends,

We'd like to let you know that work on Perseverance: Part 2 hasn't stopped, but we want to apologize to you very much that the release date has changed slightly. 

Teamwork has become significantly hampered due to the epidemic situation in Poland and worldwide. It has made it somewhat difficult. We would very much appreciate your patience and we will keep you informed about the exact date.

Perseverance: Part 2 will be three times longer than the first part, so the work on Part: 2 requires much more time. However, this will make the game much more fun for you, you will experience more excitement and you will discover much more secrets of the dark Grey Ville.

If you would like to stay in touch with us - join our Discord channel.

Regards,
Titanite Games

notes.title: Remastered Part: 1 - release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/fbe81e51eab7f9b9b2cc8bf4dd0078bd155d1ec3.png

Hello :)

A new light falls on Grey Ville!

Today we bring you the first part of the well-known and beloved visual novel - Perseverance: Part 1 in a new and refreshed graphic style.

The refreshed version of the game has just been released! And is fully prepared for you to experience Jack's story once again. With the new graphical style, we wanted to give you the opportunity to play the first part in the same graphical style as Perseverance: Part 2, which will also be released soon. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/8992de35e3f4d1d7dccce55a625d658a143dc9d1.png


Today is also the end of the giveaway (on our discord channel) - where you can win a Steam key to Perseverance: Part 1. Results will be announced on March 1.

if you missed it, check out the previous devlog.

That's all for today :) We wish you a lot of fun with the refreshed Perseverance: Part 1.

Regards,
Titanite Games
